newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Samsung targets '97 sales at $4.3 bln.
newsitem.headline: Samsung targets '97 sales at $4.3 bln.

text.p: Samsung Display Devices Co, a unit of South Korea's Samsung Group, said on Tuesday it had set the target for this year's sales at $4.3 billion, up from an estimated $3.6 billion in 1996.
The company is the world's leading maker of television picture tubes and computer monitors.
A company statement said plants in Malaysia, Germany and Mexico were due for expansion to make 10 million, 2.8 million and 3.4 million tubes per year, respectively.
It gave no figures before expansion.
Samsung expected to produce 40 million tubes in 1997 and take 18 percent of the world's market, the statement added.
